theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => use a₂, h₂, ParallelReduction.refl _
  case' par ha hb iha ihb => skip
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par ha' hb' =>
    specialize iha ha'
    specialize ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, iha.choose_spec.1.par ihb.choose_spec.1, iha.choose_spec.2.par ihb.choose_spec.2⟩
  case' par.red_I | par.red_K | par.red_S => apply symm
  case par.red_I | red_I.par ha hb =>
    cases ha
    exact ⟨_, hb, .red_I _⟩
  case par.red_K | red_K.par ha hc =>
    apply Ka_irreducible at ha
    exact ha.choose_spec.2.symm ▸ ⟨_, ha.choose_spec.1, .red_K ..⟩
  case par.red_S | red_S.par ha hb =>
    have := (Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha).choose_spec.choose_spec
    apply this.2.2.symm.subst
    exact ⟨_, (this.1.par hb).par (this.2.1.par hb), .red_S ..⟩
  all_goals
    refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩
    constructor <;> assumption

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let T := (ι (𝓕 := 𝓕)).toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF
  let C := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let M := LinearMap.mul ℂ 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra
  apply LinearMap.congr_fun₂ (f := (M.comp (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ C)).compr₂ T)
    (g := M.compr₂ ((LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (ι C)).comp T))
  apply LinearMap.ext_basis ofCrAnListFBasis ofCrAnListFBasis
  intro φs' φs
  dsimp [T, C, M]
  simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  let S := List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)
  let E := fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ
  let L := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
    S ++
    List.filter E φs'
  let R := List.filter E φs ++
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
    S
  have split l
      (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, E c :=
        by simp [E, hφψ, hψφ, crAnTimeOrderRel_refl]) :
      crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ (l ++ φs)) = L ++ (l ++ R) := by
    simpa only [crAnTimeOrderList, L, R, List.append_assoc] using
      insertionSort_of_eq_list crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' l φs hl
  trans ι (crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        (ofCrAnListF L * C * ofCrAnListF R)) 
  · congr 1
    conv_lhs =>
        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
        simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
          timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
    erw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, split [φ, ψ], split [ψ, φ]]
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, C, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF,
      ofCrAnListF_append, ofCrAnListF_cons,
      mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm,
      smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    rw [smul_sub, smul_comm]
  ·
      simp only [map_smul, map_mul]
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ),
        mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
      erw [← split []]
      by_cases hq : 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ = 𝓕.crAnStatistics φ
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq,
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [List.nil_append, map_smul, mul_smul_comm]
      · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic (Ne.symm hq), zero_mul, smul_zero]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := fun y => by
  have h_eval_qMap k :=
    Subtype.ext_iff.mp (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.2
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp_all only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X]
  simp only [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.2, Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul, Submodule.coe_add,
    get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_smul, zero_add, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
    Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul, Finset.mul_sum,
    Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intros
  ring1

theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  letI : Nonempty F := ⟨0⟩
  apply Nat.le_induction
  · intro u hp
    rw [show u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) from funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)]
    apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines
    rw [← prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq]
    simpa only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation,
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul, ENNReal.coe_natCast] using hp
  · intro n hn ih u hp
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA _ u
    apply h_interleaved_gaps _ Nat.one_le_two_pow
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt' ?_ (prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e ?_)
    · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hmem
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨r, hmem⟩
    · simp only [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun,
        multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close, ← Fin.init_def,
        ← multilinearCombine_recursive_form, ENNReal.coe_mul, ENNReal.coe_natCast]
      exact hp

theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have replace (a b : _ → _) i :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then b j else a j) =
        digits_to_num a + (b i * 10^i.1 - a i * 10^i.1) := by
    apply eq_add_of_sub_eq'
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
      ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  intro d e f h i
  simp only [hrelation, replace] at h
  choose k hk using h.1.2
  choose l hl using h.2.2
  apply (show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 by decide).pow_right |>.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  refine ⟨(∑ j, k j) - digits_to_num d - k i - l i, ?_⟩
  simp only [mul_sub, Finset.mul_sum, ← hk, ← hl i, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Fin.sum_const, Int.nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [hdigits_to_num]
  ring1
